news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹6.00 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 22 May 2026. Payment date: 19 July 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 37% but the company is paying out more than the cash it is generating. Trailing yield: 0.8%. Lower than top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Higher than average of industry peers (0.4%).

news.title: Final dividend of ₹6.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹6.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 22nd May 2026 Payment date: 19th July 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.8%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.4%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (37% earnings payout ratio) but not covered by cash flows (dividend approximately 7x free cash flows). The dividend has increased by an average of 13% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 38% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹26.95 (up from ₹23.49 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹225.3b (up 3.4% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹16.9b (up 15% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.5% (up from 6.8% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 11%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 20% growth forecast for the Electrical industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Jindal Power, Vedanta and Havells Reportedly Among 22 Bidders for Gupta Power
news.body: Jindal Power Limited, Vedanta Limited (NSEI:VEDL) and Havells India Limited (NSEI:HAVELLS) are among 22 prospective bidders that have submitted expressions of interest (EoIs) to acquire debt-laden Gupta Power Infrastructure Limited, which has admitted debtor claims of INR 42,400 million and is undergoing insolvency proceedings, people aware of the development told ET. The company, which is a manufacturer of cables, wire rods, and conductors, is being resolved under the corporate insolvency resolution process (CIRP). news.title: Havells India Limited Declares Interim Dividend, Payable on or Before 17 February, 2026
news.body: Havells India Limited announced that at the board meeting held on 19 January, 2026 the Board of Directors has declared an Interim Dividend of INR 4.00 per Equity Share of INR 1/- each i.e. @ 400% on the Equity Share Capital of the Company. The same shall be payable to all those Shareholders whose names appear in the Register of Members as on the Record Date i.e. January 23, 2026 (a separate intimation of the same has already been given to the Exchanges vide letter dated January 8, 2026). The Dividend shall be paid/dispatched to the shareholders on or before 30 days from the date of its declaration i.e. on or before 17 February, 2026.

news.title: Havells India Ltd Appoints Manjit Singh Sethi as President - Cables, Effective December 15, 2025
news.body: Havells India Ltd. has appointed Manjit Singh Sethi as President - Cables, with effect from December 15, 2025. Sethi brings over 35 years of experience in the electrical industry, having held senior leadership positions at ABB India, now Hitachi Energy, and KEC International. Across his career, he has led large transformer and cable businesses, driven profitable growth, and advanced renewable EPC initiatives. He is an electrical engineer from Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh, and holds an M.Tech in Management Studies from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi.
